tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tender Processing Fee shall not be refundable
Before Quoting the rates tenderer should read the bid document carefully
Local Suplliers are prefered for the purpose of service and Maintainance
Bidder should do installtion or service with crane only
Bidder should take Keb permmission Before installation or service of solar lights

Bidder Should Submit onsite warranty agreement in 500RS bond paper in name of PDO AS PER THE FORMAT ONLY UPLOADED IN KPPP PORTAL if bidder fails to upload bidder will be disqualified from technical bid
Bidder should submit Solar Led Lights Sample for make fair decision in tender process and upload sample subbmmission letter in kppp portal if fails bidder will be disqualified in technical bid

The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document Kc8 The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required in the standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document Kc8

Mandatory Satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least 1 similar nature of work 50 PERCENT of total cost of works

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than 7.5 lakhs Credit lines/Letters of Credit / Certificates from any Nationalized Banks as per the format for meeting the fund requirement Note(In bakercertificate clearly mention Branch Email id and Phone No) as per format Note:Solvency not accepted
